reasons.claim: The chain runs from Muhammad b. Hammam through bare relations to the grandfather, who relays the words of Ali b. al-Husayn, the last link.
reasons.quote: عن أبيه، عن جده قال: قال علي بن الحسين

reasons.claim: The Prophet's words are the saying and he is not a link; the readers differ only in the kind of the last link, which changes no route.
Abu Raja' asked al-Hasan and al-Hasan answered, so al-Hasan is the last link after the four named transmitters.
reasons.quote: قال سألت الحسن عن الطلاء المنصف، فقال لا تشربه

reasons.claim: The bare name is written as it stands.
reasons.quote: قال أنبأنا عبد الله، عن يزيد بن زريع

reasons.claim: The chain is Qutayba, Ja'far (gloss left out), al-Ja'd Abu Uthman, Anas, who tells the story.
reasons.quote: حدثنا جعفر، - يعني ابن سليمان - عن الجعد أبي عثمان، عن أنس بن مالك، قال

reasons.claim: The later mention of al-Ja'd quoting Anas repeats the same route and adds none.
reasons.quote: قال الجعد قال أنس بن مالك

reasons.claim: The gloss on Abd al-Aziz is left out and the chain continues through Abu al-Yaman, Shaddad, his father and Hamza.
reasons.quote: حدثنا عبد العزيز، - يعني ابن محمد عن أبي اليمان

reasons.claim: The second bare relation heard the Prophet and is the last link.
reasons.quote: عن أبيه، أنه سمع رسول الله

reasons.claim: The chain runs to Qatada, who relays Anas from Abu Talha, the last link.
reasons.quote: قال ذكر لنا أنس بن مالك عن أبي طلحة

reasons.claim: Qatada's closing comment is a remark, not a route.
Ibn Bazi' heard the Imam answer an unnamed asker himself, so the route is Ibn Bazi' then Abu al-Hasan.
reasons.quote: أَنَّهُ سُئِلَ أَبُو اَلْحَسَنِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ وَ أَنَا أَسْمَعُ

reasons.claim: Each branch after «ح» writes its own names down to Abu Hurayra, giving two independent routes.
reasons.quote: عن أبي هريرة، ح وحدثنا يعقوب بن حميد

reasons.claim: The note on Ibn Harmala's addition concerns wording, not a route.
Al-Sakuni relays by his own unstated chain from Ali, who speaks the saying and is the last link.
reasons.quote: رَوَى اَلسَّكُونِيُّ بِإِسْنَادِهِ قَالَ قَالَ عَلِيٌّ

reviews.uncertainty_note: «بإسناده» is an unstated gap rather than a reference to an earlier report; its kind changes no route.

reviews.question: a fully written chain after the text ending «مثله» / «نحوه» (working rule 11; here «بهذا»)

reasons.claim: The first route is Musa, Yazid, Muhammad, Umm Atiyya.
reasons.quote: حدثنا يزيد بن إبراهيم، عن محمد، عن أم عطية

reasons.claim: The chain after the text writes its own transmitters and carries this saying, so under working rule 11 it is a second route.
reasons.quote: وقال عبد الله بن رجاء حدثنا عمران، حدثنا محمد بن سيرين، حدثتنا أم عطية

reviews.uncertainty_note: If rule 11 were not adopted, the second route would be a remark.

reasons.claim: Ibn Bashshar and the unnamed others are co-transmitters from Hisham, and the gloss is left out.
reasons.quote: حدثنا محمد بن بشار، وغير، واحد، - المعنى واحد واللفظ لابن بشار قالوا

reasons.claim: Abu Rafi' relays Abu Hurayra's hadith from the Prophet, so Abu Hurayra is the last link.
reasons.quote: عن أبي رافع عن حديث أبي هريرة عن النبي

reviews.uncertainty_note: «عن حديث أبي هريرة» is an unusual wording, but it still places Abu Hurayra after Abu Rafi'.
